feat(woodii): add camellia admin shell

Summary:
- normalize permission menus into one nested route tree shared by navigation and router registration
- rebuild the default layout with page header, breadcrumbs, progress feedback, and sidebar empty state handling
- replace the stock dashboard with a menu-aware home screen and add a placeholder view for unfinished routes

Rationale:
- the existing menu tree and dynamic route tree were assembled separately, which made nested navigation and breadcrumb behavior drift apart
- route placeholders let future feature issues land incrementally without breaking authorized menu navigation
- the repo referenced unused vite plugin client typings, so removing those stale entries avoids one avoidable typecheck failure

Tests:
- npx yarn install --frozen-lockfile
- npx yarn build:dev
- npx yarn typecheck (fails on broad pre-existing repo type errors; changed files only surfaced the existing missing is_js declaration baseline)
